sources.scope: Desktop/in-app file caps and native fields. Background appearance can change in light/dark feeds.

sources.title: MOO flyer production

sources.title: VistaPrint flyer design
sources.scope: Hierarchy, grouped details, finishing and production checks. Examples can still have small essential text.

sources.title: OAAA creative best practices
sources.scope: 2021 guide pages 24–29: distance, dwell time, seven-word benchmark and context. It describes suggestions, not operator approval law.

sources.title: OAAA published billboard examples
sources.scope: 2019 historical campaigns demonstrate hierarchy; no campaign performance claim or brand-style transfer.

examples.title: Dunkin billboard
examples.observation: Short question, large product pack and visible product branding; no body paragraph.
examples.caution: Copy the hierarchy principle, not its pink palette or flat campaign treatment. No evidence here of measured campaign uplift.

examples.title: Chiquita billboard
examples.observation: Four-word message arranged around a dominant banana; brand cue separate.
examples.caution: A long feature list would compete with this simple silhouette. The seven-word benchmark is not a mandatory ceiling.

examples.title: LinkedIn FixDex and Flexis guide examples
examples.observation: Longer explanation and action are in native UI around an image.
examples.caution: The illustration contains an older event date; use it for native/image separation, not current interface geometry.

examples.title: Mailchimp product crop example
examples.observation: Product details fill tightly cropped image blocks; names and prices occupy separate lines below.
examples.caution: Tiny screenshot prices are not evidence of accessible type. Keep the surrounding email text live and test the actual column width.

examples.title: Vista event flyer by Rose
examples.observation: Large opening headline, event identity, emphasized date and grouped venue/sponsors.
examples.caution: Small address and thin script are weaker at small display size. Strong hierarchy alone cannot prove A6 print readability.

examples.title: Vista Panelfox handout
examples.observation: Headline followed by separated short feature groups and contact area.
examples.caution: Perspective mockup conceals actual printed point size. Use grouping, then verify flat art at real dimensions.

examples.title: Pinterest Balanced Table furniture example
examples.observation: Furniture and decor are visually dominant; small brand cue in the image, headline in native text below.
examples.caution: Useful product-to-scene balance; its styling is not Duroflex or Sleepyhead brand guidance.

examples.title: Google responsive image overlay examples
examples.observation: Plain food image is contrasted with competing headline/menu overlays.
examples.caution: This is an explanatory diagram for responsive image assets, not a blanket text prohibition for uploaded ads.

examples.title: Android big picture notification
examples.observation: Same photo is tiny when collapsed and large when expanded; native title carries the meaning.
examples.caution: A branded poster inserted into the attachment would become unreadable in the collapsed preview.
